current_activity: clearing Sims Ridge and completing the capture of the Galloping Horse
notes: Miller, ch. XI: after the 3rd Battalion was pulled into reserve on the morning of 12 January, Lt. Col. Herbert V. Mitchell's 2nd Battalion attacked toward Sims Ridge and Hill 53, and by nightfall of 13 January had completed the capture of the Galloping Horse. Hough, Ludwig and Shaw, Part VI, ch. 9, independently place the final Galloping Horse actions three days after 10 January. Confidence 0.7. Matches regiment claim C12925.
